title: Login — negative case (missing password)
description: One test from the auth suite: confirms the API fails loudly and correctly on a malformed request, without locking the assertion to reqres.in's exact error copy.
testTitle: login - missing password - returns 400 with error message (negative case)

title: List users — boundary case (page far beyond total)
description: One test from the users suite: what the API does when asked for a page number past the last real one — an easy case to skip by hand and a good automation candidate.
testTitle: list users - page far beyond total_pages - returns 200 with empty data (boundary case)
